hints.title: Index Mapping
hints.text: Map each string in the first list to its zero-based array index.

hints.title: Sum Evaluation
hints.text: For every element in the second list that appears in the map, compute the combined index sum.

hints.title: Minimum Collection
hints.text: Track the minimum index sum and clear or append to the output list accordingly.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash map lookup to find index sums in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops to find common elements take quadratic O(N * M) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Index map of list1 requires O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle ties properly by collecting all items sharing the minimum sum.
